Overview

Duisburg is a city in North Rhine-Westphalia with a population of 498,000. The largest inland port in Europe, a city of industrial heritage reinventing itself with green tech, culture, and affordable living. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
